faqA1: OKÜ Membership is a controlled access layer to culture, capital, and curated human networks inside OKÜ Hospitality Group. It is not a discount programme. It is access to environments, people, and rooms that are not publicly available.
faqA2: Young professionals, executives, jetsetters, and cultured individuals seeking access to premium experiences and an aspirational social environment in Panama City.
faqA3: Founders, investors, developers, HNWI and UHNWI seeking access to high-value networks, private rooms, and curated introductions in the context of Casco Viejo and Panama.
faqQ4: How does AVACA benefit from membership?
faqA4: 15% of all membership fees are allocated directly to AVACA, contributing to the cultural and urban development of Casco Viejo. When you join OKÜ, you support the district.
faqQ5: How do I join as a Founder?
faqA5: Founder membership is by invitation or application only, limited to 50 members. Submit a request and we will review it personally within a few business days.
faqA6: Patron memberships are annual. You may cancel at any time and retain access until the end of your billing period. Founder memberships are reviewed case by case.
